```python
import pyautogui, time, os, glob, zipfile, shutil, tempfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')
time.sleep(0.5)

paths = glob.glob(os.path.expanduser('~/**/Dolch_Sight_Words_Primer.docx'), recursive=True)
docx = max(paths, key=os.path.getmtime)

tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx, 'r') as z:
    z.extractall(tmpdir)

xml_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'word', 'document.xml')
ET.register_namespace('w', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main')
ns = {'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'}
tree = ET.parse(xml_path)
root = tree.getroot()

vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
for t in root.findall('.//w:tbl//w:t', ns):
    word = (t.text or '').strip()
    if word:
        run = t
        while run is not None and not run.tag.endswith('}r'):
            parent = next((p for p in root.iter() if run in list(p)), None)
            run = parent
        if run is not None:
            rpr = run.find('w:rPr', ns)
            if rpr is None:
                rpr = ET.Element('{%s}rPr' % ns['w'])
                run.insert(0, rpr)
            for old in rpr.findall('w:color', ns):
                rpr.remove(old)
            color = ET.Element('{%s}color' % ns['w'])
            color.set('{%s}val' % ns['w'], 'FF0000' if word[0] in vowels else '0000FF')
            rpr.append(color)

tree.write(xml_path, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

backup = docx + '.bak'
shutil.copy2(docx, backup)
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for folder, _, files in os.walk(tmpdir):
        for f in files:
            full = os.path.join(folder, f)
            arc = os.path.relpath(full, tmpdir)
            zout.write(full, arc)

shutil.rmtree(tmpdir)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'q')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('right')
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
os.system('libreoffice --writer "{}" >/dev/null 2>&1 &'.format(docx.replace('"', '\\"')))
```

```python
import os, re, pathlib, time
cfg = pathlib.Path.home()/".config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc"
cfg.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
text = cfg.read_text() if cfg.exists() else ""
if re.search(r'^\s*\(?undo-levels\s+\d+\)?', text, re.M):
    text = re.sub(r'^\s*\(?undo-levels\s+\d+\)?', '(undo-levels 100)', text, flags=re.M)
elif re.search(r'^\s*#?\s*\(undo-levels\s+\d+\)', text, re.M):
    text = re.sub(r'^\s*#?\s*\(undo-levels\s+\d+\)', '(undo-levels 100)', text, flags=re.M)
else:
    text = text.rstrip() + "\n(undo-levels 100)\n"
cfg.write_text(text)
time.sleep(0.5)
```
